threshold_only.label: Threshold — KPI only (any violation)
threshold_only.description: Threshold detector only on KPI data. Flags any cell with ≥1 threshold violation. Note: FDD cells (PCI_9-16) generate ~727 threshold alerts vs ~163 for TDD normal cells due to dataset capacity calibration differences.

metrics.evaluation_note: Scenario-level / cell-level detection. N=3 injected fault scenarios (congestion PCI_3, outage PCI_12, drift PCI_8) in a 16-cell synthetic dataset. This is a dataset limitation — recall/precision should not be extrapolated to real-world deployments without additional validation.

single_method_iqr.label: IQR — KPI only (distribution-based, any violation)
single_method_iqr.description: IQR/Tukey-fence detector only on KPI data. Same FDD bias as Threshold.

metrics.evaluation_note: Scenario-level / cell-level detection. N=3 injected fault scenarios (congestion PCI_3, outage PCI_12, drift PCI_8) in a 16-cell synthetic dataset. This is a dataset limitation — recall/precision should not be extrapolated to real-world deployments without additional validation.

full_ensemble.label: Full Ensemble — KPI+Stats (any violation)
full_ensemble.description: All 6 KPI + 6 Stats detectors; cell flagged if any detector fires.

metrics.evaluation_note: Scenario-level / cell-level detection. N=3 injected fault scenarios (congestion PCI_3, outage PCI_12, drift PCI_8) in a 16-cell synthetic dataset. ensemble_with_router.label: Ensemble + EventRouter (≥2 source domains)
ensemble_with_router.description: Full ensemble (KPI + Stats) + EventRouter cross-source correlation. Cell qualifies only if ≥2 source domains (kpi AND stats) both flag it.

metrics.evaluation_note: Scenario-level / cell-level detection. N=3 injected fault scenarios (congestion PCI_3, outage PCI_12, drift PCI_8) in a 16-cell synthetic dataset. This is a dataset limitation — recall/precision should not be extrapolated to real-world deployments without additional validation.

stats_count_threshold.label: Stats Count-Threshold (mean + 1.5σ, data-driven)
stats_count_threshold.description: Flags cells whose total Stats anomaly count exceeds mean + 1.5*std across all cells. Threshold computed from data — no post-hoc label fitting. Stats domain is not affected by FDD/TDD capacity bias.
